authorisation.source: author instruction in the Codex task

experiment.title: FNSPID external-review robustness pack
experiment.evidence_role: post-review diagnostics specified after all primary and evaluation results

prior_open_to_assigned_open.outcome: stock adjusted-open return from the previous SPY session to assigned open t minus the matching SPY return
prior_open_to_assigned_open.model: same daily centred-rank regression as the published baseline, with mean sentiment and log story count controls
prior_open_to_assigned_open.interpretation: A negative interval excluding zero means the association is also present before the window called next; it does not recover story arrival time.

trailing_beta_open_to_open.beta: rolling covariance of stock and SPY adjusted-open returns divided by rolling SPY variance, 252-session window, minimum 126 observations, ending at assigned open t
trailing_beta_open_to_open.outcome: stock next-open return minus trailing beta times SPY next-open return
trailing_beta_open_to_open.same_sample_rows: complete for outcome, beta, mean sentiment, negative share, and story count
specifications: unit-beta abnormal outcome on the beta-complete sample
trailing-beta abnormal outcome with baseline controls
trailing-beta abnormal outcome with centred rank of trailing beta added as a control
trailing_beta_open_to_open.era_contrast: evaluation minus development in the daily negative-share coefficient, HAC lag 5
trailing_beta_open_to_open.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg q=0.05 across the two new beta specifications separately for each regime and for their two era contrasts
trailing_beta_open_to_open.interpretation: post-review benchmark robustness only; no factor-model alpha or causal claim

contrast_dependence.daily_series: committed Notebook 75 development and evaluation negative-share coefficients
contrast_dependence.diagnostic_series: residualise the combined daily coefficient series on development and evaluation regime means before ACF and Ljung-Box tests
contrast_dependence.role: sensitivity and dependence diagnostic; no model selection by lag

fnspid_episode_robustness.difference: control downside squared return minus sentiment-overlay downside squared return
fnspid_episode_robustness.episode_definition: contiguous sessions on which the two arms differ in exposure or net return; this includes the first re-entry-cost session when applicable
fnspid_episode_robustness.leave_one_episode_out: set the observed paired downside difference to zero for one whole episode at a time, matching the Notebook 74 LSEG protocol
fnspid_episode_robustness.crash_exclusion: set the observed paired downside difference to zero from 2020-02-01 through 2020-04-30
fnspid_episode_robustness.inference: paired circular block bootstrap, block length 20, 4,999 replications
fnspid_episode_robustness.gate: survives only if every leave-one-episode-out interval and the crash-excluded interval remain above zero
fnspid_episode_robustness.interpretation: failure narrows the finding to episode-sensitive downside timing and withdraws stable risk-timing language

class_base_rates.derivation: recover exact negative, neutral and positive story counts from n, negative_share and mean_hard_label in the aggregate firm-day panel; require integer reconciliation
class_base_rates.additional_ties: report firm-day mass at negative_share equal to zero and one by era

strata: n greater than or equal to 2
n greater than or equal to 3
stratum_rank_spreads.spread: pooled observed 90th-minus-10th percentile and mean session-specific 90th-minus-10th percentile of the actual centred average-tie negative-share rank on each model sample
stratum_rank_spreads.translation: multiply each stratum coefficient by its own spread; comparisons remain descriptive

claim_boundaries: All inferential analyses in this pack are post-review and post-selection; none is independent confirmation.
Notebook 75 is not executed. Its committed aggregate daily coefficient series is read for lag sensitivity only.
The class base rates are arithmetically reconstructed aggregate counts, not a human validation of FinBERT labels.
Trailing beta changes the market benchmark but does not turn the outcome into a causal alpha.
Episode-drop results test concentration in the observed schedule and sample; they do not validate the rule out of sample.
Null, opposite-signed and adverse results are preserved without retuning.
